summary: Serve the candidate-work export report from monag panel

delivery.outcome: Add /api/export.json to `monag panel` and a matching dashboard section, so the candidate-work list (audit-untracked-issue, catalog-undescribed, taskill-doc-drift) is visible in the live panel, not only via `monag export`. Lazily computed and TTL-cached like audit/catalog; served without --radar/--hygiene since both shell out per candidate/repository and would make the panel's on-demand refresh slow.
nonGoals: The panel's export view is never enriched with --radar/--hygiene; use `monag export --radar --hygiene` directly for that.
No new data source -- export.scan() already existed (ticket-006/020/021); this only wires it into the panel.

architecture.decision: Add State.get_export() to src/monag/panel.py mirroring get_audit()/get_catalog() exactly (same TTL-cache pattern); register /api/export.json in ROUTES; add an HTML section + loadExport() following the existing audit/catalog sections.

evidence: PanelTests.test_export_is_computed_lazily_cached_and_never_enriched exercises the new /api/export.json endpoint and its HTML section

architecture.rollback: Revert the application slice through protected review.

validation.evidence: Panel export endpoint (lazy, cached, unenriched) and CLI/HTML wiring regression suite passes.
